access_token=token
lib_album_ids=set(lib_album_ids)
liked_album_ids=set(liked_album_ids)
downloaded_song_ids=set(downloaded_song_ids)
album_to_song_ids=album_to_song_ids
# determine which albums are fully downloaded
fully_downloaded_album_ids=set()
for aid, sids in album_to_song_ids.items():
    if sids and set(sids).issubset(downloaded_song_ids):
        fully_downloaded_album_ids.add(int(aid))
    # if sids empty, treat as not downloaded
keep_album_ids = liked_album_ids | fully_downloaded_album_ids
remove_album_ids = lib_album_ids - keep_album_ids
print('album_library count',len(lib_album_ids))
print('liked_album_ids',len(liked_album_ids),sorted(liked_album_ids))
print('fully_downloaded_album_ids',len(fully_downloaded_album_ids),sorted(fully_downloaded_album_ids))
print('keep_album_ids',len(keep_album_ids),sorted(keep_album_ids))
print('remove_album_ids',len(remove_album_ids),sorted(remove_album_ids))
# For verification, show each album with songs downloaded status
for aid in sorted(lib_album_ids):
    sids=album_to_song_ids.get(aid,set())
    all_dl = bool(sids) and set(sids).issubset(downloaded_song_ids)
    print('album',aid,'songs',sorted(sids),'all_downloaded',all_dl,'liked',aid in liked_album_ids,'keep',aid in keep_album_ids)
